source.title: Natural frequencies and buckling loads of beam-columns stiffened by rings

trace.notes: Original input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1816766.

Resolver discovery identified zbMATH record 1816766 as the article 'Natural frequencies and buckling loads of beam-columns stiffened by rings' with DOI 10.1016/0307-904X(96)00045-5, published in Applied Mathematical Modelling, volume 20, issue 9, pages 646-653. The MaRDI mirror exposed the title, DOI, authors, journal, keywords, and DOI landing-page link, but it did not expose full article text or problem statements.

Failure mode metadata_only with local network_or_dns_failure: local curl attempts for zbMATH, MaRDI, and the ScienceDirect article URL failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox. Browser/search recovery found the exact ScienceDirect landing page, but only title, citation metadata, keywords, and abstract were visible; no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical article body was recovered.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, DOI, PII 0307904X96000455, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, and DOI plus PDF. Candidate pages inspected or surfaced included MaRDI metadata, the ScienceDirect landing page, ScienceDirect references in later citing papers, and unrelated or different-work results. These were rejected because they were metadata-only, abstract-only, citing-paper pages, or different works; no candidate provided readable full text for the exact source.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/1816766.json and outputs/latest.json.
